caption: Temple of Athena Nike, Athens
composition: Small Ionic temple on the southwest Acropolis bastion · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the public approach beside the Propylaea, the Temple of Athena Nike is a small cream marble Ionic temple with four columns at each porch and solid side walls, standing on a tall ashlar bastion. Midday is partly cloudy, cloud cover about 39 percent, about 22.8°C, and dry. The Propylaea is at the left edge. The Parthenon is not the subject of this frame.
